description: Transform items by an affine matrix [a, b, c, d, tx, ty] in artboard terms (x right, y down): x' = a·x + c·y + tx, y' = b·x + d·y + ty, applied around the reference point. tx and ty are points

apply.description: What to transform: both (default), objects only, or pattern fills only (Transform panel menu)

matrix.description: [a, b, c, d, tx, ty]; [1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0] leaves items unchanged

origin.description: Reference point each item transforms around. Default center

scaleStrokes.description: Scale stroke weights by the matrix's area change. Default: the Scale Strokes & Effects preference

target.description: Which items to act on. Give ids (from list_items or a create tool), names, or selection: true

names.description: Item names (every item with each name)

name: apply_matrix
title: Apply Matrix
